localFacts.fact: Iberia allows one cabin bag up to 10 kg with max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm; all four full-size picks (31 / 39,4 / 40 / 43 cm folded) fit by length.
Sagrada Família normativa: photos or videos with a tripod are not allowed inside the site, except for people or companies accredited beforehand.
Alhambra (Patronato): photos only without flash and without tripod, monopod or any other camera stabilising element.
Spanish terms: rótula de bola, columna central, zapata / placa de liberación rápida; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: A tripod's nominal load says little about the real static load.
localPainPoints.fix: English post: an a6400 with the 70-350mm is about 1.028 g, so the rating is never the limit; choose on legs, head and column-down height.

quotes.text: soportan hasta 7kg nominales, lo que en términos reales no pasará de 3,5kg estáticos

localPainPoints.pain: Reaching a normal working height means raising the column, which always costs stability.
localPainPoints.fix: Rank on column-down height (Peak Design 130,2 cm, Befree 128 cm) and frame with the tilting screen from chest height on the Sirui.

quotes.text: es necesario levantar la columna, lo que siempre es una merma de estabilidad

localPainPoints.pain: Low shots and travel: Sony owners suggest a mini tripod instead of inverting the column.
localPainPoints.fix: PIXI EVO or GorillaPod 3K for low angles, tables and vlogging (English decision list).

quotes.text: Otra opción son los mini-trípodes. Muy còmodos de llevar y que van muy bien para alturas bajas.
